description: Source code for dynamic loading and dispatching of PulseAudio functions in the starboard shared pulse namespace.

methods.name: ReportSymbolError
methods.description: Logs an error message and closes the dynamically loaded PulseAudio library handle.

methods.name: pulse_load_library
methods.description: Dynamically loads the PulseAudio library and initializes function pointers.

methods.name: pulse_unload_library
methods.description: Unloads the PulseAudio library and resets the handle.
